author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Redrawn on the 45-degree axis, mirrored about it: wide body (walls 19.8 apart, rounded base), collar band 8.5 thick above a seam line, bulb teat (3/4 circle r4) on the collar top, and 3/4-circle r5 handle lobes on both walls. Every part meets the outline at a shared split point, so nothing crosses or overlaps. Base corners and collar corners use near-tangent arcs (about 3 degrees of kink, invisible at 48). No useful Lucide match (Lucide milk is upright).
omissions: Handle lobes are 3/4 circles rather than true half-discs: an exact half-disc on a 45-degree wall has no integer centre and its hole would fail the gate.
